newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK SHARES BREAK RESISTANCE AT 1454 PTS, CLIMB.
newsitem.headline: GREEK SHARES BREAK RESISTANCE AT 1454 PTS, CLIMB.

text.p: Greek equities added on to Wednesday's gains and broke resistance at this year's high of 1454.8 points in early trade with the benchmark index up 1.15 percent at 1458.3.
About 20 minutes into the session, construction shares were leading the advance, up 2.0 percent, followed by banks and industrials but trading volume was 1.5 billion drachmas.
"It's a traditional move, the market is discounting positive developments including the OTE flotation that we'll see in May and June," said Spyros Bellos, managing director at Kappa Securities.
He said the market would reach the 1500 level after the Easter break.
